liquidationSection.title: Business Exit Made Easy
paragraphs: If you're ready to close or exit your business in JAFZA, we make the entire liquidation process easy, legal, and painless.
We clear outstanding bills, cancel employee visas, follow all offboarding procedures, and deactivate your business license with JAFZA authorities.
We also handle asset transfers, final audits, and obtaining all necessary No Objection Certificates (NOCs) — so you can exit your business economically and with full confidence.

sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about JAFZA Free Zone.

items.q: What is JAFZA and what makes it perfect for company setup?
items.a: JAFZA (Jebel Ali Free Zone) is one of the UAE's largest free zones, located next to Jebel Ali Port and Al Maktoum International Airport. 100% foreign ownership, 0% tax, and world-class infrastructure for logistics, manufacturing, and trading.

items.q: What are the advantages of setting up a company in JAFZA?
items.a: 100% foreign ownership, 0% personal and corporate tax, strategic location next to the world's largest port, world-class infrastructure, and 8,000+ businesses in the ecosystem.

items.q: What types of licenses are there for a JAFZA company?
items.a: Trading, Service, Industrial, E-commerce, Innovation, and Logistics licenses — each tailored to different business activities.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a company in JAFZA?
items.a: Typically 2-3 business days with proper documentation. Our team files everything on your behalf.

items.q: Can I open a bank account with a JAFZA company?
items.a: Yes. We help open corporate bank accounts with top UAE banks based on your business profile.

items.q: What activities can a JAFZA license perform?
items.a: General trading, industrial/manufacturing, logistics & freight, consultancy, and e-commerce — plus many more specialized activities.

items.q: Do I need a physical space to set up my JAFZA company?
items.a: Yes, JAFZA requires a physical office, flexi-desk, or warehouse. We help you choose the right option based on budget and needs.

items.q: What is JAFZA Offshore and how is it different?
items.a: JAFZA Offshore is perfect for holding shares, owning property, global trade, asset protection, and IP management — no physical office or visas required.

items.q: How much does JAFZA setup cost?
items.a: Trade license from AED 12,000 + office AED 8,000-25,000 + visa AED 4,500-6,500. Year 1 total: approximately AED 27,000 - 55,000.

items.q: Can you help with liquidation if I want to close my business?
items.a: Yes. We handle the full liquidation process — canceling visas, clearing bills, deactivating licenses, transferring assets, and obtaining NOCs.
